name: Jeff
biography: Jeff has toiled for over 20 years integrating systems, performing incident response and forensics and ultimately fixing security issues. He writes for the SANS forensic blog, has spoken at RSA on SCADA security issues, DEF CON 18 on privacy issues with the google toolbar, released kinectasploit v1 at DEF CON 19 and runs p0wnlabs.com just for fun.
